newsitem.title: USA: CME hog and pork belly calls range mixed.
newsitem.headline: CME hog and pork belly calls range mixed.

text.p: Early calls on CME hog futures ranged from 0.200 cent per lb higher to 0.100 lower while indications ranged from 0.500 cent a lb higher to 0.200 lower on pork belly futures, livestock analysts said.

Mostly steady to higher cash hog indications and expected spillover demand from cattle pits following Friday's bullishly construed USDA Cattle-on-Feed report were cited as supporting factors and offset possible resistance from an overbought condition, analysts said.
Friday's higher pork cutout values were also viewed as supportive, they added.

Most analysts look for early demand in pork belly futures following Friday's strong close. A firm tone to cash bellies, the need to prompt increased storings to meet summer needs and strong technicals should boost prices, sources said. The market looks technically strong after posting a key reversal on the weekly charts, they said.
However, some analysts view the market as overbought after last week's sharp rally. Much of Friday's gain in February came on short covering, they added.
